title: TikTok Profile Videos Scraper Input
description: Scrape public TikTok creator profile video feeds from handles or profile URLs.

profileHandles.title: Profile Handles or URLs
profileHandles.description: Use this when you want videos from one or more public TikTok creator profiles. Accepts handles like nike, @nike, or full URLs like https://www.tiktok.com/@nike. Defaults to the prefilled example for testing. Not for keyword, hashtag, comment, or single-video scraping.

maxVideosPerProfile.title: Max Videos Per Profile
maxVideosPerProfile.description: Use this to cap how many videos are saved from each creator profile. Accepts integers from 1 to 10000. Defaults to 50 and the prefill is 10 for quick tests. This is the main per-profile billing guard.

maxPagesPerProfile.title: Max Pages Per Profile
maxPagesPerProfile.description: Use this as a safety cap for provider pagination on each creator feed. Accepts integers from 1 to 500. Defaults to 10 and the prefill is 1 for fast quality checks. Not a result limit by itself.

maxTotalVideos.title: Max Total Videos
maxTotalVideos.description: Use this to cap the whole run across all profile inputs. Accepts integers from 1 to 50000. Defaults to 10000 and the prefill is 50. This prevents accidental overbilling on large creator batches.

sortBy.title: Profile Sort Order
sortBy.description: Use this to request a provider-supported creator feed order. Accepted values are latest and popular. Defaults to latest. Not all providers return identical ordering for the same profile.

region.title: Region
region.description: Use this to localize provider requests with an alpha-2 country code. Example values are US, GB, FR, or PH. Defaults to US. This is not a language filter and does not translate captions.

trim.title: Trim Provider Response
trim.description: Use this to request smaller provider payloads when supported. The normalized dataset fields stay the same. Defaults to true for speed and lower memory use. Turn it off only when debugging with Include Raw Provider Data.

includeRawData.title: Include raw response Data
includeRawData.description: Use this when you need the original provider response attached to each dataset row. It helps debug field drift or build custom parsers. Defaults to false. Not recommended for AI-agent runs because raw payloads are large.
